name: deadbolt
description: DEADBOLT: Deterministic Governance Layer, 2-Hop Blast-Radius Planner, Self-Rejecting Validator, and Live Breaker Panel for the 8090 Software Factory
author: Kevin Saylor Ruschman <kruschdev@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; if (!fs.existsSync('client/node_modules')) execSync('npm --prefix client ci', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.pretest: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; const dist = 'client/dist/index.html'; const src = 'client/src/components/BreakerCockpit.jsx'; const stale = !fs.existsSync(dist) || (fs.existsSync(src) && fs.statSync(src).mtimeMs > fs.statSync(dist).mtimeMs); if (stale) execSync('npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
